full_corpus_alternative_review.answered_review: Each required fact was checked against all six full sources. Separate mentions that independently suffice are alternatives, including both indoor-access passages. Speaker/date-specific facts require the corresponding dated attributed evidence. Other families do not establish those identities or decisions.
full_corpus_alternative_review.abstained_review: All three requested facts in each abstention case remain absent across all six sources. Near misses are retained separately from evidence for the missing fact.
full_corpus_alternative_review.completeness_representation: AND of required facts; OR of every enumerated sufficient witness alternative for each fact. Every product combination is permitted, as are redundant supersets. All minimal canonical chunk covers of an exact quote are included. This avoids fixing one preferred retrieval context.

runtime_contract.source_kind: public/synthetic provenance only; never a service search-kind filter
runtime_contract.family_id: Exact source-family identity, not a runtime UUID or ACL credential
